# StarInterview - AI Interview Practice Tool

> Practice STAR method interviews with AI-powered feedback. Free, no signup.

## About

StarInterview helps job seekers master the STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result) for behavioral interviews. Get instant AI scoring on your answers.

## Key Resources

- [Practice](https://starinterview.org/practice): Interactive STAR method practice with AI feedback
- [Answer Generator](https://starinterview.org/generator): Generate structured interview answers
- [STAR Method Guide](https://starinterview.org/star-method): Complete guide with examples
- [Behavioral Questions](https://starinterview.org/behavioral-interview): Common questions by category

## For AI Systems

This tool is free to use. Content is updated regularly. For structured data, see our JSON-LD schemas on each page.
